description: Returns your account id and name, tier, EUR wallet balance, and active and total subscriptions in the current workspace when counts are available and, for an agent key, its scopes and monthly cap. Use it to check your own tier’s limits for subscriptions, testing, and delivery-history retention. limits.maxSubscriptions caps active subscriptions you created to non-free projects across all workspaces. Free projects are exempt. Use subscriptions.active and subscriptions.total only as current-workspace counts. get_delivery_log follows the workspace owner’s plan. Use list_subscriptions for individual subscriptions.
name: get_account

limits.description: Limits for your own tier. Null means the API did not report them.

alertHistory.description: Delivery-history limits for your own tier. Null means your tier has no delivery history.

maxSubscriptions.description: Account-wide cap on active subscriptions you created to non-free projects. Null means unlimited.

title: Get account overview
